# scm_ztna_connector (Resource)

Connector resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scm_ztna_connector_group" "test_group" {
  name        = "terraform-test-connector-group"
  description = "Temporary group created by terraform test"
}

resource "scm_ztna_connector" "example" {
  name        = "terraform-test-connector"
  group       = scm_ztna_connector_group.test_group.oid
  description = "Made by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The connector group id
- `name` (String) Name of the connector.

It can only be 64 characters long
and contain unicode text, space, dash, or underscore, or period.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the connector.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `oid` (String) Id of the entry.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import scm_ztna_connector.example :::oid
```
